_comment: Defaults. Entries marked observed come from samples/sample.csv only; the real HAMLOG tables are not public (see CLAUDE.md).

mode_map._comment: Key is MODE/SUBMODE. Unlisted: SUBMODE if present, else MODE.

dxcc_code._comment: DXCC entity number -> HAMLOG code (observed). Unlisted foreign entities get an empty Code and a warning.

dx_flag._comment: Column 15 by DXCC (observed; meaning unverified). default applies to unlisted foreign entities.

field_sources._comment: Which ADIF field feeds which HAMLOG column. Observed: JCC/JCG comes from COMMENT when numeric.
field_sources.name: NAME

satellite._comment: Satellite QSO: Freq column becomes <up>/<down> from band letters. V=VHF, U=UHF.

band_freq._comment: Representative MHz when FREQ is missing.

qsl._comment: adi2csv output was always J even when QSL_RCVD=Y via E; HAMLOG export shows JEE for received eQSL. Set electronic_received_jee true to emit JEE.
